newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan bank-sector shares up on arbitrage.
newsitem.headline: Japan bank-sector shares up on arbitrage.

text.p: Shares in Japan's banking sector mostly firmed in Tokyo afternoon trading on Monday on what some brokers termed arbitrage buying with TOPIX futures.

As of 0425 GMT, shares in Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi Ltd had firmed 50 yen to 1,840 yen in turnover of 1.97 million shares. Shares in Sumitomo Bank Ltd also gained 30 yen to 1,270 yen in turnover of 1.87 million.
Earlier, Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka said his ministry would firmly support Japan's major 20 banks in their effort to resolve their bad loan problems.

Asked whether Japanese authorities have a policy of not letting the major banks fail, Mitsuzuka told a parliamentary panel that the ministry would support the banks' efforts to improve their financial health.
